description: Build retention_sweeper.py daemon per spec Appendix A. Enforces 30-day expiry on evidence_blob columns. Reads from mcp_signal_scores and mcp_signal_enrichments via write_service :8772. Calculates age via DATEDIFF from recorded_at. DELETES rows where recorded_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'. Heartbeat to service_health every 60s. Graceful degradation with 30s timeout on write_service calls. Starts uvicorn within 10s. Named daemon per spec section 4.
